name: (Vampire, Vetalarana, Manipulator) Paralyzing Claws
text: Any living creature hit by a vetalarana manipulator's claw Strike must succeed at a Fortitude save save or become Paralyzed. The target can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such save. Use the moderate DC for the creature's level.
